exams.title: CSS Layout & Responsive — Topic Paper
exams.titleZh: CSS 布局与响应式 · 专题卷
exams.description: Week 2 topic paper: the CSS box model, flexbox alignment, positioning and stacking, responsive units and media queries, specificity / cascade, and overflow / grid. Ten questions, three sub-questions each, with screenshot-style mockups.
exams.descriptionZh: Week 2 专题卷：CSS 盒模型、Flexbox 对齐、定位与层叠、响应式单位与媒体查询、以及优先级 / 层叠与溢出 / 栅格。共 10 道大题，每题 3 个子题，配套截图感 mockup。

questions.title: A card wider than its column
questions.contentMdx: `card.css` styles a product card that sits inside a 320px sidebar column. In `layout.png` the card's right edge runs past the column, and the gap between the two stacked cards is smaller than the designer's `margin-bottom: 16px` plus `margin-top: 32px`. The card uses `box-sizing: content-box`.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: `card.css` declares `width: 300px`, `padding: 20px` on each side and a `3px` border on each side. What is the card's real total width, and why does `content-box` give that number?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The real width is 300 + 20 + 20 + 3 + 3 = 346px. With `box-sizing: content-box` the declared `width` sizes only the content box, so the padding and border are added on top of the 300px rather than included in it.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for 346px with the correct arithmetic (300 + padding + border).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: `card.css` 声明了 `width: 300px`，每侧 `padding: 20px`，每侧 `3px` 边框。这张卡片真实的总宽度是多少？为什么 `content-box` 会得出这个数？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 真实宽度是 300 + 20 + 20 + 3 + 3 = 346px。在 `box-sizing: content-box` 下，声明的 `width` 只决定内容盒的尺寸，所以内边距和边框是额外加在 300px 之上的，而不是包含在里面。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：算出 346px 并写出正确算式（300 + 内边距 + 边框）。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The column is only 320px wide. Explain why the card overflows, and how adding `box-sizing: border-box` changes the numbers.
subQuestions.answerMdx: 346px is wider than the 320px column, so the extra 26px spills past the column edge and either gets clipped or forces a scrollbar. With `box-sizing: border-box` the declared 300px includes the padding and border, so the total width stays 300px — inside the column — and instead the content area shrinks to 300 - 40 - 6 = 254px. So the fix moves the squeeze from the box outside to the content inside.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that the content-box total (346px) exceeds 320px and so overflows.
1 mark for explaining that border-box folds padding and border into the declared 300px, giving a 300px total and a smaller content area.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 这个列宽只有 320px。请解释卡片为什么会溢出，以及加上 `box-sizing: border-box` 后数字会怎么变。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 346px 比 320px 的列宽更宽，多出的 26px 会冲出列边缘，或被裁掉，或逼出横向滚动条。加上 `box-sizing: border-box` 后，声明的 300px 就包含了内边距和边框，于是总宽度保持在 300px——落在列内——而是内容区缩小为 300 - 40 - 6 = 254px。也就是说，这个修改把“被挤压”的位置从盒子外部挪到了内部内容上。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 content-box 的总宽（346px）超过 320px，因此溢出。
1 分：说明 border-box 把内边距和边框并入声明的 300px，总宽变为 300px，而内容区变小。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The first card has `margin-bottom: 16px` and the second has `margin-top: 32px`, yet the gap between them is only 32px, not 48px. Explain why, and give a fix that produces exactly 48px.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Adjacent vertical margins collapse: the bottom margin of one sibling and the top margin of the next meet in the middle and become a single gap equal to the larger of the two (32px), not their sum. This is margin collapsing between adjacent siblings. To get a deterministic 48px, put the cards in a flex (or grid) column and use `gap: 48px`, because `gap` is not a margin and never collapses; alternatively give a wrapper `padding` instead of using sibling margins.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that adjacent sibling vertical margins collapse to the larger value (32px), not the sum.
1 mark for a fix that avoids collapsing, e.g. `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 48px` (or wrapper padding).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 第一张卡片有 `margin-bottom: 16px`，第二张有 `margin-top: 32px`，可它们之间的间距却只有 32px，而不是 48px。请解释原因，并给出一个能得到恰好 48px 的修法。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 相邻的垂直外边距会折叠：一张卡片的 bottom margin 与下一张的 top margin 在中间相遇，合并成一个等于两者较大值（32px）的间距，而不是两者之和。这就是相邻兄弟元素之间的外边距折叠。要得到确定的 48px，可以把卡片放进一个 flex（或 grid）纵向容器里并使用 `gap: 48px`，因为 `gap` 不是外边距、永远不会折叠；另一种做法是给外层包裹元素加 `padding`，而不用兄弟 margin。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明相邻兄弟的垂直 margin 会折叠为较大的那个值（32px），而非两者之和。
1 分：给出避免折叠的修法，例如 `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 48px`（或给包裹层加 padding）。

questions.title: Buttons on the wrong axis
questions.contentMdx: `toolbar.css` styles a toolbar with `display: flex`, `justify-content: space-between` and `align-items: center`. Changing `flex-direction` to `column` was meant to keep the three buttons in a horizontal row, but in `toolbar.png` they now stack vertically and one of them is stretched full height.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: On the default `row` container, what does `justify-content` control, and how is that different from `align-items`?
subQuestions.answerMdx: `justify-content` distributes items along the main axis — horizontally for a `row` — while `align-items` aligns items along the cross axis — vertically for a `row`. They act on different axes, so changing one does not move items along the other.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for stating justify-content acts on the main axis and align-items on the cross axis (horizontal vs vertical in a row).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 在默认的 `row` 容器上，`justify-content` 控制什么？它和 `align-items` 有什么不同？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `justify-content` 沿主轴分配项目——在 `row` 下就是横向；而 `align-items` 沿交叉轴对齐项目——在 `row` 下就是纵向。它们作用在不同的轴上，所以改其中一个不会让项目沿另一个轴移动。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明 justify-content 作用于主轴、align-items 作用于交叉轴（在 row 下即横向与纵向）。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why did the buttons stack vertically after `flex-direction: column`, and which property do you change to keep them at the top while still centred horizontally?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Setting `flex-direction: column` makes the main axis vertical, so `justify-content: space-between` now spreads the buttons from top to bottom and `align-items: center` centres them horizontally. The axes have swapped roles. To pack them at the top, change `justify-content` to `flex-start` (the horizontal centring from `align-items: center` stays).
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that column swaps the main axis to vertical, so justify-content now controls vertical spacing.
1 mark for changing justify-content to flex-start (or start) for top packing.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么改成 `flex-direction: column` 后按钮会纵向堆叠？如果想让它们靠顶部对齐、同时保持水平居中，应该改哪个属性？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 设置 `flex-direction: column` 后主轴变成纵向，于是 `justify-content: space-between` 改成从上到下分散按钮，而 `align-items: center` 让它们水平居中——两个轴的角色对调了。想让它们靠顶部排列，就把 `justify-content` 改成 `flex-start`（`align-items: center` 带来的水平居中保持不变）。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 column 把主轴换成纵向，因此 justify-content 现在控制纵向间距。
1 分：把 justify-content 改为 flex-start（或 start）以实现靠顶排列。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: One button sets `align-self: stretch`. Explain what `align-self` does and the effect on that button.
subQuestions.answerMdx: `align-self` overrides the container's `align-items` for a single item, and it still works on the cross axis. With `stretch`, that one button is stretched to fill the cross-axis size of its line (the toolbar's full height in a row), while the other buttons keep their natural height and stay centred. So one button ends up full-height and the rest do not, which is the asymmetry visible in the mockup.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for stating that align-self overrides align-items for a single item.
1 mark for explaining that stretch makes that item fill the cross axis while the others do not.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 其中一个按钮设置了 `align-self: stretch`。请解释 `align-self` 的作用，以及它对那个按钮造成的影响。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `align-self` 会为单个项目覆盖容器的 `align-items`，作用对象仍是交叉轴。配合 `stretch`，那一个按钮会被拉伸，填满它所在行在交叉轴上的尺寸（在 row 下就是工具栏的整个高度），而其他按钮保持自身高度并居中。结果就是有一个按钮撑满高度、其余不会——这正是 mockup 里看到的不对称。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 align-self 会为单个项目覆盖 align-items。
1 分：说明 stretch 让该项目填满交叉轴，而其他项目不会。

questions.title: The dropdown that hides behind the banner
questions.contentMdx: `header.css` opens a nav dropdown with `position: absolute; z-index: 10`. In `dropdown.png` the dropdown is hidden behind the hero banner below it, even though its `z-index` is far higher than the banner's.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: `.header` has `position: relative; z-index: 1`, `.hero` has `z-index: 2`, and the dropdown inside the header has `z-index: 10`. Why is the dropdown still behind the hero?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Because `.header`, with a non-auto `z-index`, creates a stacking context. Inside it the dropdown's `z-index: 10` only orders elements within that header; the whole header context is painted at level 1, which is below the hero at level 2. So the dropdown cannot escape its parent's stacking context and stays behind the hero.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that the header forms a stacking context and the dropdown's z-index only orders within it, so the parent's value (1) decides against the hero (2).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: `.header` 是 `position: relative; z-index: 1`，`.hero` 是 `z-index: 2`，而 header 内部的 dropdown 是 `z-index: 10`。为什么这个 dropdown 仍然在 hero 后面？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 因为 `.header` 带了一个非 auto 的 `z-index`，从而创建了一个层叠上下文。在这个上下文内部，dropdown 的 `z-index: 10` 只用于在 header 内部排序；整个 header 上下文是以第 1 层绘制的，低于第 2 层的 hero。所以 dropdown 无法逃出父级的层叠上下文，只能待在 hero 后面。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明 header 形成了层叠上下文，dropdown 的 z-index 只在其内部排序，真正与 hero（2）比较的是父级的层级（1）。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: What is a stacking context, and name a couple of CSS properties that create one.
subQuestions.answerMdx: A stacking context is an isolated group in which the child `z-index` values are compared only with each other; the group as a whole is placed in its parent by the parent's own stacking value. It is created by a positioned element with a non-auto `z-index`, and also by things like `opacity` less than 1, a `transform` other than `none`, a `filter`, or `position: fixed`. That is why a child inside such a context can have an enormous `z-index` and still render below something outside it.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for defining a stacking context as an isolated group where inner z-index values only compare with each other.
1 mark for naming at least one creating property beyond position plus z-index (e.g. opacity < 1, transform, filter).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 什么是层叠上下文？请举出一两个会创建它的 CSS 属性。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 层叠上下文是一个隔离的分组：组内子元素的 `z-index` 只在彼此之间比较；整个分组作为一个整体，由父级的层叠值决定它在父级中的位置。它会由一个带非 auto `z-index` 的定位元素创建，也会由诸如 `opacity` 小于 1、`transform` 不为 `none`、`filter`，或 `position: fixed` 等属性创建。这就是为什么处在这种上下文里的子元素即使 `z-index` 很大，仍可能被它外部的东西压在下面。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：把层叠上下文定义为组内 z-index 只在彼此间比较的隔离分组。
1 分：举出除“定位 + z-index”之外至少一个会创建它的属性（例如 opacity < 1、transform、filter）。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Give a fix so the dropdown appears above the hero, and explain why it works.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Raise the header's own `z-index` above the hero, for example `.header { z-index: 3 }` (or lower the hero's). Because the dropdown lives inside the header's stacking context, lifting the whole header lifts the dropdown with it, so its `z-index: 10` now sits above the hero's `2`. A `z-index` on the dropdown alone cannot help, because that value is trapped inside the header's context and only competes with the header's other children.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for raising the header's z-index above the hero (or removing the header's stacking context).
1 mark for explaining why lifting the parent lifts the dropdown, while changing the dropdown's own z-index cannot.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请给出一个修法，让 dropdown 显示在 hero 之上，并解释它为什么有效。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 把 header 自身的 `z-index` 提到比 hero 更高，例如 `.header { z-index: 3 }`（或把 hero 降低）。因为 dropdown 处在 header 的层叠上下文里，抬高整个 header 就会连带把 dropdown 一起抬高，于是它的 `z-index: 10` 现在位于 hero 的 `2` 之上。只改 dropdown 自身的 `z-index` 没用，因为那个值被困在 header 上下文内部，只能与 header 的其他子元素比较。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：把 header 的 z-index 提到 hero 之上（或去掉 header 的层叠上下文）。
1 分：解释为什么抬高父级就抬高了 dropdown，而只改 dropdown 自身无效。

questions.title: The page that scrolls sideways on a phone
questions.contentMdx: `pricing.css` sets `.container { width: 1200px }` and gives each plan card a fixed `width: 360px`. On a 400px-wide phone the page scrolls horizontally, as `pricing.png` shows, and the plan cards run off the right edge.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why does a `1200px` container cause horizontal scrolling on a 400px phone but look fine on a desktop monitor?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The container has a fixed pixel width that never shrinks. On a 400px viewport — where the viewport meta makes the layout width match the device — 1200px is three times the screen, so the content overflows and the browser offers horizontal scrolling. On a desktop the viewport is wider than 1200px, so the same width fits without any overflow.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that a fixed px width does not shrink to the device width, so 1200px exceeds a 400px viewport and overflows.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么一个 `1200px` 的容器在 400px 手机上会造成横向滚动，而在桌面显示器上却看起来正常？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 这个容器用的是固定像素宽度，永远不会收缩。在 400px 的视口里——viewport meta 让布局宽度等于设备宽度——1200px 是屏幕的三倍，所以内容溢出，浏览器就给出横向滚动。桌面上视口比 1200px 更宽，同样的宽度能放得下，不会溢出。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明固定 px 宽度不会随设备宽度收缩，因此 1200px 超过 400px 视口并溢出。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Change the container so it fits narrow screens, and explain the rule you used.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Replace the fixed width with `max-width: 1200px; width: 100%`, so the container grows up to 1200px on a wide screen but never exceeds the available width, shrinking to fit a phone. Use relative units — percentages, or a flex / grid row with `1fr` — for the plan cards so they share or wrap the row instead of holding a fixed 360px. With a maximum rather than a fixed width, the content fits the viewport and the horizontal scrollbar disappears.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for replacing the fixed width with `max-width: 1200px` and/or `width: 100%` (or percentages).
1 mark for explaining that a maximum rather than a fixed width lets the element shrink with the viewport, so it no longer overflows.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请修改这个容器，让它在窄屏上也能放下，并解释你所用规则的原因。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 把固定宽度改成 `max-width: 1200px; width: 100%`，这样容器在宽屏上最多长到 1200px，但永远不会超过可用宽度，从而收缩以适应手机。给套餐卡片使用相对单位——百分比，或带 `1fr` 的 flex / grid 行——让它们共享或换行，而不是死守 360px 的固定宽度。用“最大宽度”代替“固定宽度”后，内容就能放进视口，横向滚动条随之消失。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：把固定宽度改为 `max-width: 1200px` 和/或 `width: 100%`（或百分比）。
1 分：说明用“最大宽度”而非“固定宽度”能让元素随视口收缩，从而不再溢出。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: If the page was instead missing `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, what would the phone do, and how would that change the layout? Suggest a media query that fits the fix.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Without the viewport meta a phone lays the page out at a wide default (about 980px) and then scales the whole thing down to fit the screen, so text looks tiny and percentage-based `max-width` breakpoints may not trigger as expected. Adding the meta with `width=device-width` makes the layout width equal the device width, so a rule such as `@media (max-width: 600px) { .container { width: 100% } .plans { flex-direction: column } }` now matches the phone and switches the cards to a single column. The meta and the media query work together: the meta makes the viewport realistic, the media query rearranges the layout for it.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that without the viewport meta the phone uses a wide default layout and scales it down (tiny text).
1 mark for stating width=device-width makes the layout match the device so a mobile media query like max-width: 600px applies.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 如果页面反而缺少 `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`，手机会怎么做？这又会如何改变布局？再给出一个与之配合的媒体查询。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 没有 viewport meta 时，手机会按一个很宽的默认宽度（约 980px）排版，再整体缩小到屏幕里，于是文字显得很小，基于百分比的 `max-width` 断点也可能不像预期那样触发。加上带 `width=device-width` 的 meta 后，布局宽度等于设备宽度，像 `@media (max-width: 600px) { .container { width: 100% } .plans { flex-direction: column } }` 这样的规则就能命中手机，把卡片切成单列。meta 与媒体查询是配合工作的：meta 让视口真实，媒体查询据此重排布局。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明没有 viewport meta 时手机用很宽的默认布局并整体缩小（文字很小）。
1 分：说明 width=device-width 让布局匹配设备，从而 `max-width: 600px` 之类的移动端媒体查询能生效。

questions.title: The button that refuses to be blue
questions.contentMdx: `button.css` sets `.btn { background: blue }`, but the primary button in `buttons.png` renders grey. A later rule, `.panel .btn { background: #ddd }`, is winning the cascade.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Compare the specificity of `.btn` and `.panel .btn`, and say which one wins.
subQuestions.answerMdx: `.btn` is one class, specificity (0,1,0). `.panel .btn` is two classes, specificity (0,2,0). Specificity is compared before source order, so `.panel .btn` wins even though `.btn` was intended to be the base style. That is why the primary button renders grey.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for giving the two specificity values (one class vs two classes) and concluding `.panel .btn` wins.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请比较 `.btn` 与 `.panel .btn` 的优先级，并说明哪一个胜出。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `.btn` 是一个类，优先级为 (0,1,0)；`.panel .btn` 是两个类，优先级为 (0,2,0)。优先级在源顺序之前被比较，所以尽管 `.btn` 本意是基础样式，`.panel .btn` 仍然胜出。这就是主按钮渲染成灰色的原因。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：给出两者优先级（一个类 vs 两个类），并得出 `.panel .btn` 胜出的结论。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: A teammate adds `background: blue !important` to `.btn`, and the button turns blue. Explain why `!important` wins and why this fix is discouraged.
subQuestions.answerMdx: `!important` lifts a declaration above normal declarations regardless of specificity and source order, so `.btn`'s blue now beats `.panel .btn`'s grey. It is discouraged because it breaks the normal cascade: any future rule that should legitimately override it must also carry `!important`, and even a more specific selector cannot win without one. The stylesheet turns into an escalating fight of `!important`s that is hard to reason about and maintain.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that !important overrides the normal cascade independent of specificity and source order.
1 mark for explaining why it is discouraged (it breaks the cascade and forces later rules to also use !important).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 队友给 `.btn` 加了 `background: blue !important`，按钮变蓝了。请解释 `!important` 为什么能胜出，以及为什么这种修法不被推荐。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `!important` 会把一条声明提升到普通声明之上，与优先级和源顺序无关，所以 `.btn` 的蓝色现在压过了 `.panel .btn` 的灰色。它不被推荐，是因为它破坏了正常的层叠：今后任何本应能合理覆盖它的规则都必须同样带上 `!important`，连优先级更高的选择器都离不开一个 `!important` 才能胜出。样式表会演变成一场不断升级的 `!important` 之争，很难推理和维护。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 !important 会越过正常层叠，与优先级和源顺序无关。
1 分：说明它为何不被推荐（破坏层叠、逼迫后续规则也使用 !important）。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Give a cleaner fix that makes the primary button blue without `!important`, and explain why it works.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Remove or reduce the competing rule instead of overriding it. If `.panel .btn` is really a generic default for that panel, scope it to non-primary buttons, or lower its specificity so the base `.btn` plus a `.btn-primary` modifier can win. For example keep `.panel .btn` for layout only and give the primary button a `.btn-primary { background: blue }` class whose specificity matches or beats the conflicting rule. The fix works through the normal cascade because it changes which rule legitimately outranks the other, rather than forcing an override, so it stays predictable and maintainable.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for removing or lowering the competing selector's specificity (or scoping it) instead of overriding it.
1 mark for using a proper modifier class (e.g. `.btn-primary`) and explaining that it wins through the normal cascade.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请给出一个更干净的修法，让主按钮变成蓝色且不用 `!important`，并解释它为什么有效。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 与其强行覆盖，不如移除或降低那条竞争规则。如果 `.panel .btn` 其实只是该面板的通用默认值，就把它限定到非主按钮上，或降低它的优先级，让基础的 `.btn` 加上一个 `.btn-primary` 修饰类能够胜出。例如让 `.panel .btn` 只管布局，给主按钮加一个 `.btn-primary { background: blue }`，其优先级不低于冲突规则。这个修法通过正常的层叠起作用，因为它改变的是“哪条规则名正言顺地压过另一条”，而不是强行覆盖，因此可预测、易维护。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：移除或降低竞争选择器的优先级（或对其限定作用域），而不是硬覆盖。
1 分：使用一个合适的修饰类（如 `.btn-primary`），并说明它通过正常层叠胜出。

questions.title: The notifications that spill out of the card
questions.contentMdx: `panel.css` gives the notifications card a fixed `height: 200px` and leaves the default overflow. When there are many notifications, in `notifications.png` they spill past the card and overlap the footer below instead of scrolling.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why does the content spill out of the 200px card rather than being clipped or scrolled?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The default computed value of `overflow` is `visible`, which means content larger than the box is not clipped — it paints outside the box. So the extra notifications simply draw over whatever is below the card, and the box keeps its 200px height while its content escapes.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for stating that overflow defaults to visible, so overflowing content is not clipped and paints outside the box.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么这些内容会溢出 200px 的卡片，而不是被裁掉或滚动？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `overflow` 的默认计算值是 `visible`，意思是超出的内容不被裁剪——它会画到盒子外面。于是多出来的通知就直接画在卡片下方的内容之上，盒子本身保持 200px 高，而内容跑到外面去了。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明 overflow 默认是 visible，因此溢出内容不被裁剪，会画到盒子外面。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Compare `overflow: hidden`, `overflow: auto` and `overflow: scroll` for this card, and say which fits the design.
subQuestions.answerMdx: `hidden` clips the content at the card edge, so users cannot reach the extra notifications at all — the data is lost. `scroll` always shows a scrollbar, even when the content fits, and reserves that space. `auto` shows a scrollbar only when the content actually overflows, so a short list stays clean and a long list scrolls. For a card that may have few or many notifications, `overflow: auto` fits best; `hidden` would silently hide data.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that hidden clips and loses content while scroll always reserves a scrollbar.
1 mark for choosing auto (a scrollbar only when needed) as the fit for this design.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请针对这张卡片比较 `overflow: hidden`、`overflow: auto` 与 `overflow: scroll`，并说明哪一种更贴合设计。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `hidden` 会在卡片边缘把内容裁掉，用户根本无法访问多出来的通知——数据丢失。`scroll` 无条件显示滚动条，即使内容放得下也占着那块空间。`auto` 只在内容确实溢出时才显示滚动条，所以短列表干净、长列表可滚动。对于通知可能少也可能多的卡片，`overflow: auto` 最合适；`hidden` 会悄悄把数据藏起来。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 hidden 会裁剪并丢失内容，而 scroll 总会预留滚动条。
1 分：选择 auto（仅在需要时出现滚动条）作为该设计的合适方案。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The designer later wants the card to grow with a few notifications but cap at 200px and then scroll. Give the CSS and say why it works.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Use `max-height: 200px; overflow: auto` instead of a fixed `height`. A `max-height` lets the card be shorter when there are few items and clamps it at 200px when the content is longer; at that point `overflow: auto` adds a scrollbar so every item stays reachable. A fixed `height` would force exactly 200px with empty space for short lists, so `max-height` matches the intent and the scroll only appears when it is needed.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for using `max-height: 200px` so the card can be shorter but never taller.
1 mark for pairing it with `overflow: auto` so longer content scrolls within the cap.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 设计者后来希望卡片能随少量通知增高，但最多到 200px 后就开始滚动。请给出 CSS，并说明它为什么有效。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 用 `max-height: 200px; overflow: auto` 代替固定的 `height`。`max-height` 让卡片在通知少时可以更矮，在内容更长时把高度限制在 200px；一旦到顶，`overflow: auto` 就加上滚动条，让每一项都仍可访问。固定的 `height` 会强制正好 200px，通知少时留下空白，所以 `max-height` 更贴合意图，滚动条也只在需要时才出现。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：使用 `max-height: 200px`，让卡片可以更矮但不会更高。
1 分：配合 `overflow: auto`，让较长内容在上限内滚动。

questions.title: The grid that crushes its cards on a phone
questions.contentMdx: `grid.css` lays out product cards with `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px`. On a 400px phone the four columns are squeezed so thin that each 240px card spills across its track, as `grid.png` shows. The designer expected the cards to settle into fewer columns automatically.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: How many columns does `repeat(4, 1fr)` create, and how is the container's width divided between them?
subQuestions.answerMdx: `repeat(4, 1fr)` creates exactly four columns, each `1fr`. The free space (the container width minus the three 24px gaps) is split into four equal parts, so each column is one quarter of it — roughly `(400 - 72) / 4 = 82px` on a 400px phone — no matter how narrow that becomes.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for stating that four equal `1fr` columns are created and the width is split evenly (allowing for the gaps).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: `repeat(4, 1fr)` 创建了几列？容器宽度是如何在它们之间分配的？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `repeat(4, 1fr)` 恰好创建四列，每列 `1fr`。可用空间（容器宽度减去三条 24px 间隙）被分成四等份，于是每列占四分之一——在 400px 手机上约 `(400 - 72) / 4 = 82px`——无论它变得多窄。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明创建四列、各为 1fr，宽度平均分配（考虑 gap）。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why do the 240px cards break the layout on the phone, and how does `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))` fix it?
subQuestions.answerMdx: A `1fr` track can shrink below its content's minimum and does not wrap, so on the phone the four tracks end up far narrower than the 240px cards, which then overflow and overlap. `minmax(240px, 1fr)` gives each track a 240px minimum and a `1fr` maximum, and `auto-fit` fits as many 240px-or-wider tracks as the container allows, collapsing the rest and wrapping the cards onto fewer columns (a single column at 400px). So the same grid becomes responsive without a media query.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that a fixed four-column `1fr` grid does not wrap and its tracks shrink below the card width, so the cards overflow.
1 mark for explaining that `minmax(240px, 1fr)` plus `auto-fit` fits as many 240px tracks as possible and wraps to fewer columns.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么 240px 的卡片在手机上会撑坏布局？`repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))` 又是怎么修好它的？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `1fr` 轨道可以缩到低于内容最小宽度，而且不会换行，所以在手机上四条轨道远比 240px 的卡片窄，卡片随之溢出、互相重叠。`minmax(240px, 1fr)` 给每条轨道设 240px 的下限和 `1fr` 的上限，`auto-fit` 则在容器允许的范围内尽量多放“至少 240px”的轨道，把多余的轨道收掉、让卡片换到更少的列（400px 下就是一列）。于是同一个栅格无需媒体查询就变成响应式的。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明固定的四列 `1fr` 栅格不会换行，轨道会缩到小于卡片宽度，导致溢出。
1 分：说明 minmax(240px, 1fr) 配合 auto-fit 会尽量多放 240px 的轨道并换到更少的列。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: What is the difference between `auto-fit` and `auto-fill` here, and what does `gap` contribute?
subQuestions.answerMdx: With `auto-fill` the browser creates as many 240px tracks as fit and keeps the empty ones, so on a wide screen the cards stay 240px and the leftover space sits in empty tracks. With `auto-fit` those empty tracks are collapsed and the `1fr` maximum lets the real cards stretch to fill the row instead, so they grow into the extra width. `gap` adds a uniform 24px between tracks (and rows) without margins, so the spacing stays consistent and no cell is crushed against its neighbour.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that `auto-fill` keeps empty tracks (cards stay 240px) while `auto-fit` collapses them and lets the remaining cards stretch.
1 mark for stating that `gap` gives uniform space between rows and columns without margins.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 这里 `auto-fit` 与 `auto-fill` 有什么区别？`gap` 又起什么作用？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 用 `auto-fill` 时，浏览器会创建尽可能多的 240px 轨道并保留空轨道，于是在宽屏上卡片仍是 240px，剩余空间留在空轨道里。用 `auto-fit` 时这些空轨道被收掉，配合 `1fr` 上限让真实卡片拉伸填满整行，从而长进多出来的宽度。`gap` 在轨道（和行）之间加上统一的 24px 间隔而不靠 margin，所以间距保持一致，单元格也不会挤到一起。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 auto-fill 保留空轨道（卡片保持 240px），auto-fit 收掉空轨道让剩余卡片拉伸。
1 分：说明 gap 在行列之间提供统一间隔、无需 margin。

questions.contentMdxZh: `grid.css` 用 `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px` 排布商品卡片。在 400px 手机上，四列被挤得极窄，每张 240px 的卡片都横跨自己的轨道溢出，正如 `grid.png` 所示。设计者本以为卡片会自动落到更少的列上。

questions.title: The heading that doubles every time it nests
questions.contentMdx: `theme.css` sizes typography in `em`: `.panel { font-size: 1.2em }`, `.card { font-size: 1.2em }` and `.card .title { font-size: 1.2em }`. With the browser's 16px default, the title in `typography.png` renders far larger than the intended 1.2×, and the same markup nested one level deeper grows again.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: What is `em` measured against, and how is that different from `rem`?
subQuestions.answerMdx: `em` is relative to the element's own computed `font-size`, which is inherited from its parent — so a nested element's `em` is measured against its parent's already-scaled size. `rem` ("root em") is always relative to the root (`html`) font size, whatever the nesting depth.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for stating that `em` is relative to the element's (inherited) font size and `rem` to the root font size.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: `em` 是相对于什么来计算的？它和 `rem` 有什么不同？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `em` 相对于元素自身计算出的 `font-size`，而这个值是从父级继承来的——所以嵌套元素的 `em` 是相对于父级已经缩放过的字号来算。`rem`（root em）则始终相对于根元素（`html`）的字号，与嵌套层级无关。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明 em 相对于元素自身（继承来的）字号，rem 相对于根字号。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why does the title compute to about 27.6px rather than 19.2px, and why does nesting it one level deeper grow it again?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Each `em` size multiplies the parent's computed size. Starting at the 16px root: `.panel` → 16 × 1.2 = 19.2px, `.card` → 19.2 × 1.2 = 23.04px, `.title` → 23.04 × 1.2 = 27.65px. That is 1.2 cubed, not 1.2 once. Because `.title` inherits from `.card`, which inherited from `.panel`, one more wrapping element with `font-size: 1.2em` multiplies again (27.65 × 1.2 ≈ 33.2px) — that compounding is the bug.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for showing the multiplication chain (16 → 19.2 → 23.04 → 27.65), i.e. 1.2³.
1 mark for explaining that each nested level inherits the parent's already-scaled size, so adding a level multiplies again.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么标题算出来约 27.6px，而不是 19.2px？再深嵌一层为什么又变大？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 每个以 `em` 计的字号都会乘以父级计算出的字号。从 16px 的根开始：`.panel` → 16 × 1.2 = 19.2px，`.card` → 19.2 × 1.2 = 23.04px，`.title` → 23.04 × 1.2 = 27.65px。这是 1.2 的三次方，而非乘以 1.2 一次。因为 `.title` 继承自 `.card`、`.card` 又继承自 `.panel`，再多一层带 `font-size: 1.2em` 的包裹元素就会再乘一次（27.65 × 1.2 ≈ 33.2px）——这种累积正是 bug。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：写出相乘的链条（16 → 19.2 → 23.04 → 27.65），即 1.2³。
1 分：说明每一层都继承父级已缩放的字号，所以多加一层就再乘一次。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Give the fix using `rem` and explain why it removes the growth; then name one case where `em` is still the right choice.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Switch the `font-size` values to `rem` (e.g. `.title { font-size: 1.2rem }`). Every `rem` is measured against the single root font size, so the title is always 1.2 × 16 = 19.2px no matter how deeply it nests — there is no multiplication chain. `em` is still useful for properties that should scale with the element's own text, such as `padding` or `border-radius` in `em`, so a button's padding grows when its font size does. The rule of thumb: use `rem` when you mean "relative to the page" and `em` when you mean "relative to this element".
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for switching the font sizes to `rem` and explaining that `rem` removes the compounding (all relative to the root).
1 mark for correctly noting `em` is still appropriate for sizes that should scale with the element's own font size (e.g. padding).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请给出用 `rem` 的修法并解释它为什么消除了增长；再说明什么情况下 `em` 仍是正确选择。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 把 `font-size` 的取值改成 `rem`（例如 `.title { font-size: 1.2rem }`）。每个 `rem` 都相对单一根字号，所以无论嵌套多深标题都恒为 1.2 × 16 = 19.2px——没有相乘链条。而 `em` 对于需要随元素自身文字缩放的属性仍有用，比如以 `em` 计的 `padding` 或 `border-radius`，这样按钮字号变大时内边距会跟着变大。经验法则：想表达“相对页面”就用 `rem`，想表达“相对本元素”就用 `em`。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：把字号改成 rem，并说明 rem 消除了累积（都相对根字号）。
1 分：正确指出 em 仍适合需要随元素自身字号缩放的尺寸（如 padding）。

questions.titleZh: 每嵌套一层就翻倍增长的标题
questions.contentMdxZh: `theme.css` 用 `em` 设置排版字号：`.panel { font-size: 1.2em }`、`.card { font-size: 1.2em }`、`.card .title { font-size: 1.2em }`。在浏览器默认 16px 下，`typography.png` 里的标题远大于预期的 1.2 倍，而且同样的结构再深嵌一层还会继续变大。

questions.title: The sticky header that scrolls away
questions.contentMdx: `layout.css` gives the section header `position: sticky; top: 0` so it should pin to the top while its list scrolls. In `sticky.png` it scrolls away with the content instead. An ancestor `.page` sets `overflow: hidden`.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: What does `position: sticky` do, and how does it differ from `position: fixed`?
subQuestions.answerMdx: `sticky` is a hybrid: the element behaves like `relative` (stays in flow) until the scroll crosses the `top`/`left` threshold, then it sticks — but only within its containing block and its scroll container. `fixed` takes the element out of flow and pins it to the viewport, so it never scrolls and does not stay inside any parent.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for describing `sticky` as relative-until-threshold then pinned within its scroll container, and `fixed` as pinned to the viewport.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: `position: sticky` 的作用是什么？它和 `position: fixed` 有何不同？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `sticky` 是一种混合体：元素先像 `relative` 一样留在流中，直到滚动越过 `top`/`left` 阈值才吸附——但只在它的包含块和滚动容器范围内。`fixed` 则把元素移出文档流并钉在视口上，所以它永不滚动，也不会留在任何父级之内。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明 sticky 在越过阈值前是相对定位、之后固定在滚动容器内，fixed 则固定在视口上。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why does the exactly-correct `top: 0` fail to stick here?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Sticky sticks relative to its nearest scroll container, not the page. `.page { overflow: hidden }` makes `.page` that scroll container, and because `hidden` produces a scrollport that never actually scrolls (its content fits and it is not user-scrollable), the sticky element has no scroll range to stick within — so it just scrolls away with the page. The `overflow: hidden` ancestor both clips the header and steals the 'scroll container' role from the viewport.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that sticky uses its nearest scrolling ancestor, and an `overflow: hidden` ancestor becomes that scrollport.
1 mark for explaining that because that ancestor does not scroll, the sticky element never engages and appears to scroll away.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么明明写对了 `top: 0`，还是吸不住？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: sticky 是相对它最近的滚动容器吸附的，而不是相对页面。`.page { overflow: hidden }` 让 `.page` 成了那个滚动容器，而 `hidden` 产生的是一个从不真正滚动的滚动口（内容放得下、用户也无法滚动它），于是 sticky 元素没有可吸附的滚动范围——它只能随页面滚走。这个 `overflow: hidden` 的祖先既裁掉了标题，又从视口手里抢走了“滚动容器”的角色。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 sticky 相对最近的滚动祖先吸附，而 `overflow: hidden` 的祖先正是那个滚动口。
1 分：说明由于该祖先并不滚动，sticky 从不触发，看起来就像滚走了。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Give two fixes and explain why each restores the pinning.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Either (1) remove `overflow: hidden` from `.page`, so the sticky element's nearest scroll container is again the viewport (the page scroll) and the header pins to the top of the window; or (2) if you truly need clipping, split the roles: keep the sticky element outside the clipped element, or make that ancestor the intended scrolling region with a fixed height and `overflow: auto`, so it actually scrolls and the sticky pins to its top. In both cases the fix works because it gives the sticky element a scroll container that really scrolls, which is the one thing sticky needs.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for one valid fix (remove the `overflow: hidden` ancestor, or move the sticky element out of it).
1 mark for the alternative (make the ancestor a real scroll container with a set height plus `overflow: auto`) with the reason that sticky needs a genuine scrollport.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请给出两种修法，并解释每种为什么能恢复吸顶。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 要么（1）去掉 `.page` 上的 `overflow: hidden`，让 sticky 元素最近的滚动容器重新变回视口（页面滚动），标题就能吸在窗口顶部；要么（2）如果确实需要裁剪，把角色拆开：让 sticky 元素处在被裁剪元素之外，或把那个祖先做成真正的滚动区域——固定高度加 `overflow: auto`，让它真的能滚动，sticky 便会吸在它的顶部。两种修法都有效，因为它们都给 sticky 元素提供了一个真正会滚动的滚动容器，而这正是 sticky 唯一需要的东西。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：给出一种有效修法（去掉 overflow: hidden 的祖先，或把 sticky 元素移出它）。
1 分：给出另一种修法（把祖先做成真正的滚动容器：设定高度 + overflow: auto），并说明原因是 sticky 需要一个真实的滚动口。

questions.title: The dialog that sits in the corner
questions.contentMdx: `modal.css` tries to centre a dialog with `.modal { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50% }`. In `modal.png` the dialog appears offset toward the bottom-right instead of being centred in its overlay.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why does `top: 50%; left: 50%` place the dialog down and to the right instead of centred?
subQuestions.answerMdx: `top: 50%` and `left: 50%` position the element's top-left corner at the centre of its containing block. The dialog then extends its full width and height down-right from that corner, so its centre ends up half its own size below and to the right of the overlay's centre.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that `top`/`left` move the element's top-left corner to the centre, so the box extends down-right and is offset by half its size.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么 `top: 50%; left: 50%` 会把对话框放到右下，而不是居中？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `top: 50%` 与 `left: 50%` 把元素的左上角放到包含块的中心。对话框随后从这个角向右下方向铺开整个宽高，于是它的中心比遮罩中心低、右各偏移了自身尺寸的一半。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：说明 top/left 把元素左上角移到中心，盒子向右下延伸、因而偏移自身一半尺寸。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Give a transform-based fix and a second approach, and explain how each accounts for the dialog's own size.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Transform fix: keep `top: 50%; left: 50%` and add `transform: translate(-50%, -50%)`, which shifts the dialog back by half its own width and height, cancelling the offset. Second approach: if the dialog has a known size, `inset: 0; margin: auto` centres it, because the auto margins absorb the equal free space on both sides. A third, size-agnostic way is to centre the overlay's flex child: `.overlay { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center }`, which puts the dialog in the middle whatever its size. All three account for the dialog's real size instead of ignoring it.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for the `translate(-50%, -50%)` fix with the reason that it cancels the half-size offset.
1 mark for a second working approach (e.g. `inset: 0` + `margin: auto`, or flex centring on the overlay) that still centres without ignoring the size.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请给出一个用 transform 的修法，再给出第二种做法，并说明它们各自如何处理对话框自身的尺寸。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: transform 修法：保留 `top: 50%; left: 50%` 再加 `transform: translate(-50%, -50%)`，把对话框按自身宽高的一半反向平移，抵消那个偏移。第二种做法：如果对话框有已知尺寸，用 `inset: 0; margin: auto` 居中，因为 auto 外边距会吸收两侧相等的剩余空间。还有一种与尺寸无关的方式：在遮罩上居中它的 flex 子元素 `.overlay { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center }`，无论对话框多大都把它摆在正中间。三者都考虑了对话框的真实尺寸，而不是忽略它。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：给出 translate(-50%, -50%) 修法，并说明它抵消了半尺寸的偏移。
1 分：给出第二种可行做法（如 inset:0 + margin:auto，或在遮罩上做 flex 居中），无需忽略尺寸即可居中。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The team later turns the dialog into a viewport-covering modal: the overlay becomes `position: fixed; inset: 0` centring the dialog with flex. Explain why `fixed`, and why flex centring is more robust than the translate trick.
subQuestions.answerMdx: A modal backdrop must cover the entire viewport and stay put while the page scrolls, so `position: fixed` (relative to the viewport) is correct, whereas `absolute` is measured from a positioned ancestor and could be clipped or scroll with the content. `inset: 0` sizes the overlay to the viewport on all four sides, giving a full-screen backdrop. Centring the dialog with `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center` needs no knowledge of the dialog's size and no magic `-50%` values; it also keeps the dialog centred when its content changes its height, whereas a baked-in `translate` can drift or interact badly with other transforms and animations on the same element.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining that `fixed` is viewport-relative and keeps the backdrop covering the screen while the page scrolls (versus `absolute`).
1 mark for explaining that flex centring is size-agnostic and avoids magic `translate` offsets / transform conflicts.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 团队后来把对话框做成覆盖视口的模态框：遮罩改为 `position: fixed; inset: 0`，并用 flex 居中对话框。请解释这里为什么用 `fixed`，以及为什么 flex 居中比 translate 技巧更稳健。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 模态遮罩必须覆盖整个视口并在页面滚动时保持不动，所以 `position: fixed`（相对视口）是对的；而 `absolute` 会以某个定位祖先为参照，可能被裁剪或随内容滚动。`inset: 0` 让遮罩四边都撑到视口，形成全屏背景。用 `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center` 居中对话框，无需知道对话框尺寸、也不需要写死的 `-50%`；当对话框内容变化导致高度改变时它仍能正确居中，而写死的 `translate` 可能偏移，或与同一元素上的其他 transform / 动画相互干扰。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：说明 fixed 相对视口、能在页面滚动时让遮罩保持覆盖（对比 absolute）。
1 分：说明 flex 居中与尺寸无关，避免了写死的 translate 偏移 / transform 冲突。
